decisions.statement: A size is stated as `WxH` and is at fault stated any other way.
A generation size is between 256 and 4096 and falls on a multiple of 16.
A guidance scale or a step count the caller left unsaid is left off the body.
The image is answered as the first `b64_json` datum the service carried back.
A timeout says the pool serves one request at a time so the wait counts the queue.

definition: an image asked of the MLX image service from a prompt
